name: wildcat-vna
description: A VNA tab that drives a NanoVNA over USB and teaches what it reads, drawn as an instrument in five places: Measure (SWR at Meshtastic and MeshCore on 7-segment LCD digits with an SWR meter, a grade and a verdict; zone-coloured SWR / return loss / R & X views and a glowing Smith chart), Trim (a live trim assistant: where the antenna resonates against the target, which way to go, every change logged, "you passed it"), Library (antenna cards each in its own colour, history and A/B compare), QC (PASS/FAIL stamp, CSV log, certificates) and Bands (2 m, 70 cm, 1090, 433, FM and your own presets, each calibrated into its own save slot; power-on is always slot 0, unchanged). Presses answer on the first click; one session sweeps for all; ⤢ opens any view in its own tab; 📸 Export makes a report card. /vna, /vna save <name>, /vna trim, /vna band <id>, /vna compare <a> <b>, /vna qc, /vna tab <view>, /vna export, /vna guide, /vna hide|show (the status line, shown only while a NanoVNA is connected and also written to ~/.claude/mod-status for the Herdr strip, which replaces it inside Herdr). New in 0.7.0: three tools for Claude (vna_reading, vna_antennas, vna_action: read the antenna and your Library, and do the safe button presses; never calibrate, the power-on save or deleting) and the antenna-coach skill, which teaches reading SWR and coaching a trim
